Fitz Gessler is heading out on his first German tour; bringing his laid-back, sharp take on life in Germany to the stage.

Originally from New Zealand 🇳🇿 with German parents 🇩🇪 and now based in Berlin, Fitz has become a familiar face across Europe’s comedy scene, performing everywhere from small clubs to theaters. His mix of Kiwi and German gives a unique perspective rarely seen.

You might recognise him from his stand-up clips online (with millions of views 👀), where he shares funny, honest observations about German culture, dating, and family life.

Social Media: @fitz_comedian

This show will have a strong focus on life in Germany with stories from his childhood and other anecdotes since then.

😊 What to expect:
A relaxed, fun night of comedy with plenty of laughs, relatable stories, and a fresh outsider’s perspective on life in Germany.

✨ Why come along?
If you enjoy stand-up that feels personal, current, and easy to connect with, this is a great chance to see a rising comic in an intimate setting before he gets even bigger.

🎟️ Tickets are already in demand—grab yours and come enjoy a great night out.

📍Lost Weekend
🚪Doors open at 17:30
⏰Showtime at 18:00
🇬🇧 The show is in English

Line Dance Lessons at LostWeekend 👯‍♀️
Ready to learn the moves? Join us from 6:30–8:00pm for dedicated line dance lessons in a fun, welcoming atmosphere.
Whether you’re completely new to line dancing or looking to build on the basics, our instructor will guide you step-by-step through the dances, helping you gain confidence and have a great time on the floor, catering to all levels.
These classes are standalone sessions — perfect for anyone who wants to improve their skills, get moving, or learn more dances for our CMN parties.
15€ per person. Grab your boots and come dance with us! 👢

Experience the Power of Poetry at Lost Poets Open Slam!
Calling all poets—whether you’re stepping onto the stage for the first time or you’re a seasoned performer, this is your chance to shine! Hosted by Happy Writing Co., the Open Slam Night is all about celebrating the art of spoken word and performance in a welcoming and supportive environment.

Event Details:

Doors Open: 7:00 PM
Sign-Ups: 7:15 PM (at the stage)
Mic Goes Live: 7:30 PM

How It Works:
The night kicks off with sign-ups at 7:15 PM, right at the stage. We’ll take the first 10 poets who sign up, so be sure to arrive early to secure your spot. Each poet has up to 4 minutes to share a piece that resonates with the evening’s theme.

This is more than just a competition—it’s an opportunity. For new poets, it’s a chance to gain confidence, explore the world of performance, and connect with a community that loves to support emerging talent. For experienced poets, it’s the perfect platform to test out new material and sharpen your delivery before taking it to larger stages.

Evening Breakdown:

Round 1: 4 poets perform
Break: 10 minutes
Round 2: 4 poets perform
Break: 10 minutes
After we’ve heard from all the poets, the audience will cast their votes, and we’ll crown the Slam Poet of the Month—an honor that recognizes not just talent but the courage to stand up and share your voice.

Open Mic Session:
From 8:30 to 9:00 PM, we’ll open the stage to everyone. This non-competitive open mic session is your chance to share whatever’s on your mind or in your heart, in a space where creativity flows freely and all voices are heard.

Why Take the Stage?
Our Open Slam Night is designed to encourage poets of all levels to grow, experiment, and find their voice. Whether you’re polishing a piece for a larger audience or taking your first step into performance, you’ll find a supportive community ready to cheer you on.

An evening to enjoy the increasingly popular country lifestyle. Bust out your boots and hats (if you like) and enjoy an evening of hot new country hits and classics.
Feel free to join in on some line dancing – instructors will be introducing at least one new dance per night and are available to help anyone out!
Or just be entertained by the music and atmosphere amongst other like minded fans of country music with some great food and drinks.
Doors @ 19:00

HOW TO SIGN UP

  • Sign-up Window: 19:15 – 19:45 (before the music starts).

  • Process: Write your name and your Instagram handle on a slip of paper and drop it in the box. Everyone who plays gets tagged.

  • Selection: 20 slots per night. Performance order is drawn from the box completely at random.

YOUR SLOT

  • Format: 1 Slot = 2 songs, up to 10 minutes maximum.

  • Timing: Your time starts as soon as your name is called (setup included). Wrap it up when the host gives you the sign—anything past 10 minutes cuts into someone else’s time.

  • Limit: Maximum 2 slots per night per singer (guest spots in other sets count toward this limit).

NEED SOMETHING SPECIAL?

  • Special Requests: If you need backing vocals, a bigger setup, or an early/late slot, let the team know early or note it on your paper slip.

  • Contact: Ask for your host, Kerim, at the bar. The earlier you reach out, the more they can help.

IT’S EVERYONE’S NIGHT.

  • Got Good Pics From Tonight? Tap here and send them to us.

  • Note: Photos are taken throughout the night. Slots cannot be guaranteed.

Instagram: @OPENSTAGEMUC | @LOSTWEEKENDMUNICH

Microphones, DI boxes and a Digital Piano are setup for everyone to use.

Just come down on the night and let’s have some fun!

Free entry
